preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
preconditions.description: The input root must be either None or an instance of TreeNode, representing the root of a binary tree.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, TreeNode) for node in [root] if node is not None)
preconditions.description: Every node in the tree must be an instance of TreeNode, with valid left and right attributes.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= node.val <= 10**5 for node in [root] if node is not None)
preconditions.description: Each node's value must be an integer between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == [] if root is None else True
postconditions.description: If the input root is None, the output must be an empty list.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= val <= 10**5 for val in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every value in the output list must be an integer between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The length of the output list must match the number of nodes in the tree (preorder traversal count).
The output list must exactly match the preorder traversal of the tree (Root->Left->Right).
